question: 每个月的订单量是多少？相比上个月的增长比例是多少？（首月增长记空）

    month,
    order_count,
    CASE

question: 3 月每个一级类目里 GMV 最高的商品是哪个？
pred_sql:
SELECT c1.name AS top_category, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN categories c1 ON c.parent_id = c1.id
WHERE replace(substr(o.created_at,1,7),'/','-') = '2025-03'
  AND LOWER(o.status) IN ('paid','shipped','completed')
GROUP BY c1.id, p.id
HAVING gmv = (
    SELECT MAX(gmv2)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            c2.id AS cat_id,
            SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price - oi2.discount) AS gmv2
        FROM orders o2
        JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id
        JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.id
        JOIN categories c3 ON p2.category_id = c3.id
        JOIN categories c2 ON c3.parent_id = c2.id
        WHERE replace(substr(o2.created_at,1,7),'/','-') = '2025-03'
          AND LOWER(o2.status) IN ('paid','shipped','completed')
        GROUP BY c2.id, p2.id
    ) sub
    WHERE sub.cat_id = c1.id
)
ORDER BY c1.id
gold_sql: SELECT category, product FROM (SELECT p1.name AS category, p.name AS product, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p1.id ORDER BY SUM(d.gmv) DESC) AS rn FROM daily_product_metrics d JOIN products p ON d.product_id=p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.id JOIN categories p1 ON c.parent_id=p1.id WHERE d.date LIKE '2025-03%' GROUP BY p1.id, p.id) WHERE rn=1

question: 退款率（退款金额/销售金额）最高的前 3 个卖家是谁？
pred_sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name, 
       COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity - oi.discount), 0) AS refund_rate
FROM sellers s
JOIN products p ON s.id = p.seller_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.id = r.order_item_id
WHERE LOWER(o.status) IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'completed')
